decisions.title: Use SQLite for v1 storage
decisions.rationale: Zero-ops, single file, easy to back up. We do not need concurrency or scale yet.
decisions.impact: ms-mvp signup storage targets a local SQLite file; a hosted DB is deferred until after launch.
decisions.plain: We agreed to store data in a single-file database for the first version, since we do not need scale yet.

decisions.title: Defer user accounts / auth until after launch
decisions.rationale: The MVP only collects emails. Building auth now would delay launch for a feature no early user needs.
decisions.impact: ms-mvp scope drops login/signup accounts; ms-feedback may re-open this once we see demand.
decisions.plain: I am proposing we leave user accounts and login until after launch, since the first version only collects emails. Awaiting your approval.
